they think they have him, how
wrong they are.

text.inkscape:label: Life in the Saddle

tspan.tspan: Life in the Saddle

text.tspan: All members of a Cowboy faction may mount/dismount without expending a Move action. Cowboys may also Stampede large animal herds
more easily than other factions (see Stampede, Corebook page 17).

text.inkscape:label: Tough as Old Boots

tspan.tspan: Tough as Old Boots

text.tspan: Once per turn, if a character is facing a Nerve test that will put them out of action, the Cowboy player may declare they are “tough as old
boots”. The test is passed on an unmodified roll of 3 or greater.

text.inkscape:label: See How the Cat Jumps

tspan.tspan: See How the Cat Jumps

text.tspan: Following the playing and revealing of all Initiative cards, the player may play a second, face down Initiative card to a character of their choice.
The owning player may look at the card without revealing it to their opponent. It may be used to replace the original placed Initiative card.
Cowboys do not have to have half of the faction armed with a pistol as their sole ranged weapon. If mounted Characters are permitted in the
Scene, then all mounted Characters may be equipped with a lasso. “See How the Cat Jumps” and “Tough as Old Boots” may not be used
in the same turn; only one is permitted to be played in a single turn. “Life in the Saddle” applies at all times.
